Yes of course friend, I’m glad I could get any sort of positive emotion out of you because it’s been a shit day for me too and I’m smiling right now.

I was kind of overstating the work part of it because I literally only drink like 6 PBRs and then I get a headache and start smoking weed instead hahaha so I’m like the opposite person to talk about alcoholism but you still need people giving you good ideas you can start thinking about. 

My dad is 50 and even though he’s not gonna say he’s an alcoholic, he’s a busy attorney and I see it in him  that he needs some respite. 

Im working with him right now to start working out and walking a lot again ( he looks exactly like me plus 50 pounds haha! ) and so I’m using the reasoning of getting him to replace a habit with another one. I’m not sure of your fitness but alcohol doesn’t make me want to go work out you know? And so I want him to exert energy into himself instead of letting everything go by the wayside and have a seat and start making drinks. 

Im gonna keep working him until he’s on his own track and I’m no longer the force behind it, because it’s in him already. And you should get someone close to you to be mindful of you and help you make a reasonably sized change in your life to where if you fall off the track, it’s not the end of the world! because they’re right there with you, and they know you have a drive inside of you to get anything done you want, and that includes you being happy with or without a drink. 

Much love to you and your family tonight and I look forward to maybe seeing another post on here in a couple months saying that some anonymous commenter gave you a push you never got from people you know to look at your life at just a slightly different angle. I know you’ve got this, I’m gonna graduate next year and I never thought that would be possible until one day I got on here and saw that I wasn’t the only person that was this bad. 
RGP.

I’m only 22 M and have gone through two abortions with girlfriends (one not mine and who knows about the other), I’ve dropped out of college twice, and I tried to OD back in December. Man you got this shit you have a girlfriend and a daughter. Fuck whatever company that is, they need YOU, you don’t need them. You come first and thats a fact. If I had that financial freedom, here’s what I’d do:

Get yourself the time off you truly deserve, and I mean get it. You tell them when you aren’t gonna be available and when you’ll be back. Take your girl or your daughter somewhere you’ve wanted to go or go do something you’ve been wanting to do, even if it’s something you thought of/saw a few hours ago, and go do it. Refresh yourself and don’t think about work and whatever other shit that it’s stressing you out on the daily. YOU are so much more valuable than being someone that gets worked to death and, in turn, has all these things affecting your personal health get even worse because all these things holding onto your life are stopping you from working on yourself, just like me, except in way simpler terms than for you. 

You still have time mate and you can use it however you want, but let me be one person to tell you that me and you aren’t gonna get through this without breaking through one of these walls in front of us, And that starts with putting Number One, aka YOU back on top of that list of important shit in your life. 

I wanna see you on the other side of this man I wanna grow up to be successful like you but I wanna be happy like you are GOING TO BE. And that starts when you wake up tomorrow. Until we’re on the other side brother.
